verification.note: Refresh of 18 Oct 2026 under the rule that level A needs the instrument's own text or an official register. Stored and read: NIA's copy of the guideline (nia.or.kr, PDF, 216 pages, version of 29 April 2026, stored 12 Oct 2026 and unchanged when the archiver checked it on 18 Oct 2026; pages 1 to 6 have no text layer), MSIT's online form for high-impact AI confirmation requests (msit.go.kr, the record's secondary source, same dates) and NIA's notice of 22 January 2026 distributing the AI Basic Act guidelines, stored in this run. The guideline confirms the title (in its own FAQ), the Article 33(3) basis, the two-step test, the area table of Article 2(4), the examples, the confirmation procedure and its non-binding character. The cover image shows the English title 'Guidelines for Determining High-Impact AI Systems' and the logos of MSIT and NIA, but no date, and no page of the text dates the guideline. The publication date and the revisions of 29 January, 13 February and 29 April 2026 therefore rest on NIA's notice (its date, its revision notices and the file name 260429), an announcement that counts as alt-official, so the record is level B. The notice also says that the posted files are the current versions. The archiver flagged the notice for review because it barely mentions the guideline's title; it is the notice that distributes the guideline files.

changes.verification.note: rewritten for this refresh: the guideline carries no date, and the publication and revision dates rest on NIA's notice, an announcement, which counts as alt-official (level B); NIA's notice is now stored for this record

judgment.status_reasoning: The guideline says it is not legally binding and serves to support operators in meeting their duties (FAQ, page 214); MSIT's confirmation-request form tells operators to review it first. NIA's notice (copy of 18 Oct 2026) lists the version of 29 April 2026 as the current file, with no later revision. 'Published (non-binding, current)' and 'Non-binding' stand.
judgment.date_reasoning: No page of the guideline's text gives its date, and the cover image shows none. 2026-01-22 (notice date) and the revision of 29 April 2026 (revision notice and file name 260429) rest on NIA's notice, an announcement, so they have alt-official support only.
judgment.scope_reasoning: Unchanged: national government guidance on the criteria for high-impact AI under the AI Basic Act; in scope with no note.

open_questions: The cover and contents page of the guideline show the issuer's own English title, 'Guidelines for Determining High-Impact AI Systems', as images without a text layer, so it cannot be quoted; the record's title is a rendering of the Korean title. With an OCR text layer for pages 1 and 3 (or a maintainer's decision), the title could become the issuer's English title.
